title: FIGO FOR FIFA PRESIDENT? FIFA'S FINAL LIST SAYS NO
description:
UEFA reportedly wanted him to take on Infantino. FIFA's list has three names, and his isn't one.

Luis Figo, FIFA president? Not on this list. UEFA reportedly tried to recruit him against Infantino this month. Wenger said no, Csanyi was considered, and only then did Figo's name come up. Call that a waiting list, not a plan.

FIFA's final list has three names: Infantino, Diallo and Tashima. Figo isn't one of them, despite a CV with a 2000 Ballon d'Or and 127 caps for Portugal. These days he's in clothing and calls it an industrial project, not a hobby. At least shirts need no ballot.

Should a former player like Figo run FIFA? Yes or no, and make your case in the comments.
